gaps: Gives no calibration procedure at all: no dry/single/dual/triple-point sequence, no calibration standard values (e.g. 12,880 or 80,000 uS/cm), no order of operations.
Never states the numeric K value of the 'K 1.0' cell constant in body text; K 1.0 appears only in the product name and headings.
Gives no temperature-compensation coefficient and no method for converting raw EC to specific conductance at 25 C, despite having no internal temperature sensor.
States accuracy as a single +/- 2% figure with no breakdown by range, by temperature, or at the extremes of 5 uS/cm and 200,000 uS/cm.
Gives no storage instructions, no storage solution, and no storage-life figure (unlike the pH, ORP and DO datasheets which state ~5 years).
Gives no maintenance interval: cleaning is described as a technique, never as a schedule.
Gives no conversion to salinity, TDS or PSU, and no ppm conversion factor.
Gives no drift rate, no expected reading stability over time, and no acceptance criteria for deciding a reading is bad.
Gives no guidance on what conductivity values are normal or abnormal for any water body; it is a hardware document with no environmental interpretation.
Names the 'Basic EZO Inline Voltage Isolator' and 'i2 InterLink' but gives no wiring diagram, voltage, or connection procedure for them.
Lists 'Mixed aqueous/organic', 'Samples containing Heavy metals', 'Soil Samples' and 'Strong reducing agents' with no label saying whether these are supported applications or contraindications.
summary.notes: Two-chunk document; chunk 1's first ~400 characters are overlap repeating the K-constant and recalibration text that originates in chunk 0, so those claims are recorded only on chunk 0. The document contradicts itself on recalibration: the front spec table states '~10 years  Time before recalibration' while the body states flatly that 'recalibration is not necessary' after the first calibration. The applications page is OCR-scrambled: bullets for supported uses and bullets for apparent contraindications are interleaved with no separating heading. The dimension and materials pages arrive as bare numbers and material names with their labels detached, so several figures (Ø 8mm, Ø 2.6mm, 15.5mm, 16mm, 29mm, 37.6mm, 112.7mm, 150.3mm) cannot be reliably attached to a named feature and were not extracted as claims. This is the only one of the four probe datasheets that claims recalibration is unnecessary.
